source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: ServerService.kt starts the Ktor server, whose RouteResolver routes OpenAI or Anthropic requests to their handlers. These go through InferenceGateway and InferenceRunner which drive the LiteRT engine, then the requests are logged in the database.
